fields.notes: DDR4's protocol-level DFT surface is the Multi-Purpose Register, Connectivity Test mode, ALERT_n error reporting, latched CRC status, and the temperature sensor. Controller/PHY scan/BIST remain SoC concerns; conformance is established by JEDEC JESD79-4 testing.

exposed_dft_features.name: ZQ Calibration
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Output driver Ron and ODT Rtt trim.

exposed_dft_features.name: Qoff (MR1 A12=1)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Output buffer disable for IDD measurement.

fields.no_jtag_on_DRAM_balls: DDR3 SDRAM has no JTAG / boundary-scan / scan-shift pins.
controller_side_dft_aids: Per-byte-lane PHY observability: DDR3 PHY IP typically exposes RX FIFO contents, calibration FSM state, eye margin sweep, per-bit deskew settings via a control register interface (vendor-specific).
Logic-analyzer / oscilloscope probing of CK / CK# / CKE / CS# / RAS# / CAS# / WE# / DQ / DQS / DQS# / DM / ODT on the DIMM edge or board-level test points.
ECC (SEC-DED) at the system level on x8 ECC ranks — detects single-bit errors and corrects them, doubles as a DRAM defect / soft-error indicator.
MPR predefined pattern as a deterministic read self-test pattern through the PHY.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Multi-Purpose Register (MPR)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Read predefined / training / error / temperature data without the array (MR3).

in_band_test_facilities.name: Connectivity Test (CT) mode
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Boundary connectivity test via TEN / ALERT_n.

out_of_band_test_facilities: Module SPD-based configuration and vendor ATE (implementation-defined).
